notes.title: Bugfix Update 1.1.20250909
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed visual bug where turn order list would not update correctly after swapping.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where certain weapons for zikaron and agata would silently and unexpectedly deal additional damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where certain weapons for zikaron and agata would not proc ailments as often as expected.[/p][/*][*][p]Force of Nature no longer bypasses stun or sleep ailments.[/p][/*][*][p]Force of Nature CAN now be affected by "seconds".[/p][/*][*][p]Fix audio volume blip when quitting the game in certain ways.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various issues affecting battle actor positioning involving "seconds".[/p][/*][*][p]Increased drop rates for certain rare items on certain rare encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved various NPC dialogue, Story screen triggers for improved clarity around endgame sidequests[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash during a cutscene in ch.10 (and possibly in other rare scenarios).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash when changing scenes while a "camera hint" is present on-screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to enemy balancing in the final dungeon, Jerome's side quest, and on hard mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed logging errors when loading saves and on Windows/MacOS when accessing certain navigation functions in ch.11 (may fix some rare crashes).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typo for a specific location name on the ch.11 minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some other minor dialogue/typos.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed/improved some minor map issues.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed visual bug where turn order list would not update correctly after swapping.
Fixed bug where certain weapons for zikaron and agata would silently and unexpectedly deal additional damage.
Fixed a bug where certain weapons for zikaron and agata would not proc ailments as often as expected.
Fix audio volume blip when quitting the game in certain ways.
Fixed various issues affecting battle actor positioning involving "seconds".
Fixed a rare crash during a cutscene in ch.10 (and possibly in other rare scenarios).
Fixed a rare crash when changing scenes while a "camera hint" is present on-screen.
Fixed logging errors when loading saves and on Windows/MacOS when accessing certain navigation functions in ch.11 (may fix some rare crashes).
Fixed typo for a specific location name on the ch.11 minimap.
Fixed some other minor dialogue/typos.
Fixed/improved some minor map issues.

tags.balance_change: Force of Nature no longer bypasses stun or sleep ailments.
Force of Nature CAN now be affected by "seconds".
Increased drop rates for certain rare items on certain rare encounters.
Adjustments to enemy balancing in the final dungeon, Jerome's side quest, and on hard mode.

notes.title: Bugfix Update 1.1.20250901.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Make turbo work outside of battle

[*] (Prologue) Le Dernier's moves now correctly scale off of magic

notes.title: Bugfix Update 1.0.20250901
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixes two more softlocks when traversing the world map in certain ways in the final chapter.[/p][list][*][p]Added a world map "recovery mode" accessible from the debug menu to help people get out of any similar softlocks in case we've missed any (please continue to report these!); tap on the version number on the config menu from the title screen to access the debug menu[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo in the Config menu helptext for one of the options[/p][/*][*][p]Made the movement puzzle in Ben's chapter more forgiving, significantly more so when the "Casual" difficulty mode is enabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a missing out of bounds collision in the final dungeon[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: QUARTET is NOW LIVE! Release trailer, Oxford commas, Patch 1.1 and more!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, y'all![/p][p][/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that Quartet has officially launched and the response has been absolutely incredible! We're currently holding strong with a [b]Metacritic score of 87[/b], and we couldn't be more grateful for the amazing reception from players and critics alike.
[/p][p][b]Watch our Release Trailer:[/b] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x1dtKybfyaE"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]In a delightful turn of events, we even hit the front page of Reddit today for our most obscure configuration option: the Oxford Comma toggle![/p][p][b]Check out the viral thread here:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/gaming/comments/1n1vswb/in_my_42_years_i_have_never_seen_such_an_obscure"]https://www.reddit.com/r/gaming/comments/1n1vswb/in_my_42_years_i_have_never_seen_such_an_obscure[/url][/p][p]And give it some more love![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/c1a42746a3dafcb410bfb301d5d14f077c9a3c95.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Zero-day Patch:[/b][/p][p]We have also shipped a new patch that is LIVE NOW:[/p][list][*][p][b]Bug:[/b] Save Files were not transferring from Demo to Full Game when playing on the Steam Deck[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Coming soon in Patch 1.1:[/b][/p][p]We were listening to the discourse on the Steam forums as well as the features folks are expecting. We're already hard at work on our first update, which will include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Hard Difficulty Mode[/b]: For those seeking an even greater challenge (Part of version 1.1!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Turbo Button for Battles[/b]: Speed through encounters at your own pace (Part of version 1.1!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Streamer Mode:[/b] A mode for Streamers, point your streaming software "Image Sources" overlay to your save file and automatically update your front-row party display overlay for your stream (1.1 update!)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/17f904887044864763c3f314871452a490a7b652.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Support Ongoing Development[/b][/p][p]Your support directly fuels future updates and content! By purchasing Quartet now, you're helping us continue to enhance and expand the game with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and additional content down the road.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/4e45c0456bcc63b6bc8c16fc3e5de3e148b62ca6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of this incredible launch. The journey through the world of Quartet has only just begun![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Team Something Classic[/p]

tags.bug: Save Files were not transferring from Demo to Full Game when playing on the Steam Deck

tags.feature: Hard Difficulty Mode: For those seeking an even greater challenge (Part of version 1.1!)
Turbo Button for Battles: Speed through encounters at your own pace (Part of version 1.1!)

Streamer Mode: A mode for Streamers, point your streaming software "Image Sources" overlay to your save file and automatically update your front-row party display overlay for your stream (1.1 update!)
